findings.text: For LocalDatetime, LocalDate and LocalTime values, the encoder calls `v.In(time.UTC).Format(format)`. The value was parsed in a fixed zone with the machine's local offset, so converting to UTC shifts the wall-clock time by that offset. With a +02:00 local zone, `10:00:00` is encoded as `08:00:00`. A local date near midnight can move to the previous day. The encoder should format the value in its own location, without calling `In(UTC)`.
